obligations.requirement: The Headless backend consumes only an immutable FramePlan at the Render Core boundary and does not expose Skia/platform types.
obligations.oracle: Compile the backend through the public renderer-neutral header, inspect public includes and the exact changed-path dependency scan, and assert one const FramePlan submission.
obligations.acceptance: Public headers contain no Skia/platform dependency; the backend accepts only const FramePlan and returns the existing typed BackendSubmissionResult.
obligations.evidence_required: Focused Headless backend contract output and review-owned public-boundary scan.

obligations.requirement: Identical FramePlan input rendered with the locked prebuilt Skia SDK produces byte-identical fixed-size RGBA readback and digest.
obligations.oracle: Render the same distinguishable nine-kind FramePlan twice with fixed raster dimensions, color configuration, and no platform surface; compare exact RGBA bytes, dimensions, and digest. The test constructs expected RGBA bytes independently using hand-authored integer-aligned fixture regions and a test-only rectangle/path fill reference, then compares actual bytes and independently computes the digest.
obligations.acceptance: Both submissions are accepted and readback bytes/digest are identical; the exact golden digest is recorded without treating digest as a replacement for structural plan equality.
obligations.evidence_required: Committed Headless raster/golden evidence JSON and focused test transcript.

obligations.requirement: The Headless backend handles all nine G3-03 reference command variants deterministically, with Group retaining traversal semantics but contributing no pixels.
obligations.oracle: Use a hand-authored distinguishable nine-kind FramePlan fixture. Assert all nine command variants are traversed in order, each pixel-contributing kind changes its assigned region, Group contributes zero pixels, and the expected byte vector is not obtained by invoking the backend under test.
obligations.acceptance: All nine variants are accepted through the same private backend path; no semantic lookup or alternate scene traversal occurs.
obligations.evidence_required: Nine-kind fixture inventory, independent expected-pixel corpus, command/raster assertions, and exact digest inputs.

obligations.requirement: Invalid headless configuration or malformed plan input is rejected deterministically without canonical or FramePlan mutation or partial publication.
obligations.oracle: Inject invalid raster configuration and identity-mismatched/empty plan cases; compare plan and backend observation before/after each rejection.
obligations.acceptance: Typed rejection is deterministic, prior successful observation remains unchanged, and no surface/presentation publication is attempted.
obligations.evidence_required: Negative-path test output and rejection evidence JSON.

obligations.requirement: G3-05 does not pull forward surface lifecycle, platform hosts, optimized caches, or later G3 work and preserves G3-01 through G3-04 and RF01/G2 behavior.
obligations.oracle: Review-owned changed-path/dependency scan plus G3 focused matrix, RF01/G2 predecessor matrix, and git diff --check.
obligations.acceptance: Only authorized Headless backend paths differ; predecessor tests pass and all forbidden dependency scans are empty.
obligations.evidence_required: Changed-path inventory, dependency scan, predecessor logs, and diff check.
